mainEntity.name: How much does a BMW 8 Series 840i engine replacement cost in the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: A BMW 8 Series 840i engine replacement typically costs £3,800-£6,000 for a reconditioned supply-only B58 unit, or £5,000-£8,000 fitted by a specialist. Used engines start from £2,000 but carry higher risk. Dealer prices can reach £7,500-£10,000+ for a full replacement.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of B58 engine failure in a BMW 8 Series 840i?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common warning signs include coolant loss (often from the expansion tank, water pump or plastic fittings), whistling noises from the engine (PCV valve failure), loss of power or misfires (HPFP or injector issues), and the inability to measure engine oil (oil pump failure warning).

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a BMW 8 Series 840i?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes - a BMW 8 Series 840i is worth £30,000-£90,000+ depending on age and mileage. A £5,000-£8,000 rebuilt engine is a fraction of the car's value and preserves its long-term reliability. For cars worth under £15,000, evaluate carefully; but the 840i comfortably exceeds this threshold.

mainEntity.name: How long does a BMW 8 Series 840i engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A BMW 8 Series 840i engine replacement typically takes 10-14 labour hours for a specialist workshop, spread over 2-3 working days depending on parts availability. The B58's longitudinal mounting and 8-speed ZF transmission make access straightforward compared to transverse layouts.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between the BMW 840i and BMW 840d engines?

acceptedAnswer.text: The BMW 840i uses the B58 3.0-litre twin-power turbo petrol straight-six (333-340hp), while the 840d uses the B57 3.0-litre twin-turbo diesel straight-six (320hp). The 840i is lighter, revs more freely and suits drivers prioritising refinement; the 840d offers higher torque (680Nm vs 500Nm) and better fuel economy but carries EGR and DPF-related risks.

mainEntity.name: Should I repair or replace the engine in my BMW 8 Series 840i?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the issue is coolant system-related (water pump, expansion tank, hoses), repair is usually the right choice - costs £500-£1,500 at a specialist. If the engine has been overheated causing head gasket or bottom-end damage, or if oil starvation has occurred, replacement with a rebuilt B58 is safer and often more cost-effective than a patchwork repair.

historyTimeline.h2: BMW 8 Series 840i - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: The BMW 8 Series 840i launched in July 2019 as the entry-level petrol model in the revived G15 8 Series range, powered by BMW's acclaimed B58 3.0-litre straight-six. The 840i has remained the core petrol variant across Coupe (G15), Convertible (G14) and Gran Coupe (G16) body styles, with power outputs varying slightly between 333hp and 340hp depending on year and market.

milestones.description: July 2019 - B58B30 (340hp, 500Nm), 3.0-litre twin-power turbo inline-six, launch specification for Coupe and Convertible
B58B30C variant introduced, 340hp, fitted to 840i xDrive models
Power output adjusted to 333hp in some UK-market 840i variants; B58B30M0 and B58B30M1 codes appear
March 2022 - G15 LCI (facelift) introduced; 840i xDrive produces 333hp @ 5500-6250rpm, 500Nm @ 1700-4000rpm
present - B58B30C remains the primary engine code across 840i models

historyTimeline.closingNote: Every engine fitted to the BMW 8 Series 840i is covered below, with UK rebuilt pricing and known failure points.

commonProblems.h2: BMW 8 Series 840i Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The BMW 8 Series 840i's B58 engine is widely regarded as one of BMW's most robust modern powerplants, but it has several well-documented weak points. The B58 family - fitted to every 840i since launch - is fundamentally reliable, but coolant system failures, PCV valve issues and fuel system problems do occur, typically from 60,000 miles onward. Rebuilt B58 engines supplied through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing the original failure points, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Coolant System Failure - Why the BMW 8 Series 840i B58 Engine Loses Coolant Prematurely
problems.rootCause: The B58 engine uses plastic water pump housings, expansion tank fittings and coolant crossover pipes that become brittle with heat cycling. Cracks develop, causing slow or sudden coolant loss. Overheating can lead to head gasket failure if not caught early.【17†L7-L9】

Replace pump, expansion tank, hoses, crossover pipes

repairOptions.longevity: When overheating has caused internal damage (warped head, failed head gasket)

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical BMW 8 Series 840i (2019-2022) is worth approximately £30,000-£55,000, with newer examples (2023-2025) valued at £50,000-£90,000+. The 840i sits in the £15,000+ band: replacement cost is typically small relative to vehicle value. A £5,000-£8,000 rebuilt engine is a financially sound investment for a car worth £30,000-£55,000.
problems.recommendation: For a BMW 8 Series 840i, coolant system repairs are almost always worthwhile given the high residual value of the car. If caught early (before overheating), a water pump or coolant system overhaul is the sensible choice. If the engine has been overheated and internal damage is suspected, a rebuilt B58 with upgraded components offers better long-term reliability than a patch-and-repair approach on a damaged block.

problems.h4: PCV Valve & Oil System Failure - BMW 8 Series 840i B58 Oil Consumption and Vacuum Leaks
problems.rootCause: The B58's PCV (positive crankcase ventilation) valve is integrated into the cylinder head cover and can fail, causing increased oil consumption, rough idle, whistling noises and vacuum leaks. Oil pump failure (plastic pump components) has also been reported on 2018-2023 B58 engines.

problems.rootCause: The B58's high-pressure fuel pump can fail, causing loss of power, misfires, long cranking times and, in severe cases, engine stalling. Fuel injector failure is also reported on 2020-2024 BMW 840i models.
